name: Abstract Algebra
strandNote: Not needed to be hired. Modular arithmetic and permutations come up at interview.
description: Study groups, rings and fields, from clock arithmetic to polynomials.

lessonObjectives.l1-symmetries: Combine the symmetries of a square and see that they form a group.
lessonObjectives.l2-group-axioms: Check the group axioms and prove that identities and inverses are unique.
lessonObjectives.l3-modular-arithmetic: Work modulo $n$ and find which residues have inverses.
lessonObjectives.l4-cyclic-groups: Find the order of an element and the generators of a cyclic group.
lessonObjectives.l5-subgroups: Prove a subset is a subgroup with the one-step test.
lessonObjectives.l6-cosets: List the cosets of a subgroup and prove that they split the group into equal pieces.
lessonObjectives.l7-lagrange: Prove Lagrange’s theorem and use it to rule out subgroup sizes.
lessonObjectives.l8-permutations-and-cycles: Write a permutation in cycle notation and find its order.
lessonObjectives.l9-odd-and-even: Find a permutation’s sign, and show why the 15-puzzle cannot always be solved.
lessonObjectives.l10-homomorphisms: Prove a map is a homomorphism and find its kernel.
lessonObjectives.l11-normal-subgroups: Tell when a subgroup is normal and build the quotient group.
lessonObjectives.l12-first-isomorphism-theorem: Prove the first isomorphism theorem and use it to identify a quotient.
lessonObjectives.l13-fermat-and-euler: Prove Fermat’s little theorem and Euler’s theorem from Lagrange’s theorem.
lessonObjectives.l14-rings: Check the ring axioms for the integers, matrices and residues modulo $n$.
lessonObjectives.l15-fields: Prove that the integers modulo a prime form a field.
lessonObjectives.l16-polynomials: Add, multiply and divide polynomials with coefficients in a field.
lessonObjectives.l17-roots-and-factors: Use the factor theorem and test small polynomials for irreducibility.
